FIELDS.NAME: Superior Surfaces Installation
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Superior Surfaces Installation specializes in the installation of high-quality countertops and surfaces, including natural stone and engineered materials such as granite, quartz, marble, and laminate. Our operations encompass end-to-end project management, from initial consultations and measurements to the precise cutting, fabrication, and installation of surfaces in residential and commercial spaces. We ensure that all installations comply with local building codes and fire safety regulations, employing skilled installers with documented training and experience in handling the materials we work with. We utilize written safety protocols during all installation activities and conduct thorough risk assessments before commencing projects to identify and mitigate potential hazards. All work is underpinned by clear, signed contracts that outline project scope, payment terms, and timelines, thus minimizing the risk of disputes and enhancing customer satisfaction. Our commitment to quality is reinforced through partnerships with reputable material suppliers and ongoing inspections to maintain exceptional installation standards.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On March 10, 2023, during a countertop installation project at a residential property, a piece of granite was accidentally chipped while being maneuvered into place. The estimated cost to repair the damage was $1,250.00. The loss status is resolved as the homeowner agreed to cover the repair expense, ensuring no claims were filed.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday: 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM; Saturday: 9:00 AM - 2:00 PM; Sunday: Closed
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class III Safe, UL Listed, 1 Hour Fire Rated
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Secure fencing and on-site watch personnel during installation projects.
